payload.artist_html: N. R. Longrich, A. A. Ramirez Velasco, J. Kirkland, A. E. Bermúdez Torres, C. I. Serrano-Brañas
payload.credit_html: "Coahuilasaurus lipani, a New Kritosaurin Hadrosaurid from the Upper Campanian Cerro Del Pueblo Formation, Northern Mexico" (combined from Figures 6 and 7)
payload.description_html: IGM 6685, holotype of Coahuilasaurus lipani, in (A), left lateral view; (B), right lateral view, (C), line drawings in left lateral view, (D), line drawings in right lateral view. Abbreviations: de, dentary; dt, dentary teeth; lab, labrum; lp, lateral process; mt, maxillary teeth; mw, maxillary wing; na, naris; nf, narial fossa; np, nasal process; od, oral denticles; os, occlusal shelf; pmx, premaxilla; pd, palatal denticles; pp, palatal process; sym, symphysis; vo, vomer; vp, ventral process. Scale = 20 cm.
